scope.description: Comprehensive repository-level audit of current LongLineage acceleration methods, historical comparable evidence, lossless data/output reduction, performance claim discipline and private GitHub publication readiness. This task does not substitute for the deferred seven-dataset P7 worker matrix or authorize scientific-kernel approximations.

assumptions: Only same-scope measurements may support a numeric speed or resource-reduction claim.
Frozen scientific decisions, RNG consumption, exact-test ceilings and topology completeness cannot be changed for performance.
GitHub credentials must never be written into repository files or task evidence.
GitHub publication is limited to a verified private liaoyoyo/LongLineage repository.

inputs.path: external://InterSubMod/research/20260718_solver_methyl_edge_probe/20260719_最簡演化樹與VAF排序AI交接重點_01.md

step_verify.step: Trace every current or planned acceleration to code, contract, historical evidence and a semantic-invariance condition.
step_verify.verify: The audit distinguishes IMPLEMENTED, PLANNED and HISTORICAL_ESTIMATE rows and gives a repository path for every row.

step_verify.step: Select only lossless reductions that preserve frozen inputs, read eligibility, RNG consumption, exact tests, candidate families and output order.
step_verify.verify: Every accepted optimization has explicit forbidden shortcuts and a Step-to-Verify gate with digest, count or resource metric.

step_verify.step: Verify repository governance and deterministic test evidence after documentation or bounded implementation changes.
step_verify.verify: JSON schema checks, check-state, CTest and scripts/ci/check_all.sh exit 0; any deferred full-data claim remains a blocker.

step_verify.step: Repair GitHub CLI authentication without exposing credentials and publish only to the private remote.
step_verify.verify: gh auth status exits 0, gh repo view reports PRIVATE, pushed branch commit equals local HEAD and a draft PR URL is recorded.
